model.title: Set up {name}
model.description: Select the exact model for {name} ({address}). Close the Anker app before continuing. Encryption negotiation is slow, so verification can take several minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read telemetry. Make sure the device is awake, the Anker app is disconnected, and an active Bluetooth proxy has a free connection slot. The Home Assistant log records the underlying Bluetooth error.
error.invalid_telemetry: The device connected but did not report telemetry this integration recognises. Select a different model, or check firmware support in SolixBLE.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.not_supported: This advertisement is not supported or the Bluetooth adapter cannot make active connections.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Solix devices were found. Enable Bluetooth on the device and place it near an active Bluetooth proxy, then try again.

init.title: Telemetry polling
init.description: Seconds between telemetry sessions (30-3600). Each session releases its Bluetooth connection after receiving data.
